title: Buttons Silence alarms not working
symptom: The 'Buttons silence alarms' feature is not working on a Samsung S10 Plus with Android 10, making it difficult to silence alarms at night. It used to work on an S7.
cause: Android restricts apps from capturing global button presses when the phone is locked or the app is not in the foreground, and newer Android versions have tightened these restrictions.
fix: Use the ascending volume profile as an alternative: Settings -> Alarms and Alerts -> Glucose Alerts Settings -> Alert Volume Profile, which starts the alarm at a low volume and gradually increases it, allowing the user to snooze before it gets loud.
settings_changed: Alert Volume Profile → ascending volume profile
evidence_quote: If you choose the ascending volume profile, the alarm starts at very low volume. Your selected sound file plays at the very low volume. Then, in 1 minute, the same sound file is played at slightly higher volume.
